China Wok Menu: Explore Unique Offerings That Will Delight Your Taste Buds

When it comes to satisfying your cravings for Chinese cuisine, few places deliver the variety and quality quite like China Wok. With an extensive menu featuring everything from appetizers to specialty dishes, China Wok offers something for everyone. Whether you’re in the mood for a quick takeout or a delightful dining experience, China Wok’s offerings promise to delight your taste buds. In this comprehensive guide, we’ll explore the best menu deals, provide detailed pricing tables, and highlight unique offerings that you won’t want to miss.

Fried Rice

Fried rice is a staple in many Chinese restaurants, and China Wok is no exception. Their fried rice dishes are made with perfectly cooked rice stir-fried with a variety of ingredients. Below is a table summarizing the fried rice offerings:

Dish Description Price
Vegetable Fried Rice A medley of fresh vegetables sautéed with fluffy rice. $8.99
Chicken Fried Rice Tender pieces of chicken cooked with vegetables and rice. $9.99
Shrimp Fried Rice Succulent shrimp combined with vegetables and rice. $10.99
Beef Fried Rice Flavorful beef stir-fried with rice and vegetables. $10.49
Special Fried Rice A combination of chicken, shrimp, and pork in fried rice. $11.99

Special

The special section of the China Wok menu features unique dishes that you won’t find elsewhere. These chef’s specials are crafted to provide a memorable dining experience.

Dish Description Price
Chef’s Special A seasonal dish crafted by the chef using fresh, local ingredients. $12.99
Special Diet Menu Health-conscious options available upon request, featuring steamed vegetables and lean proteins. Prices vary.

Appetizer

Start your meal off right with one of China Wok’s delectable appetizers. These small bites are perfect for sharing or for enjoying solo.

Dish Description Price
Spring Rolls Crispy rolls filled with fresh vegetables. $5.99
Crab Rangoon Creamy crab filling wrapped in wonton skin and fried to perfection. $6.99
Chicken Satay Grilled chicken skewers served with a special sauce. $7.99

Beef

China Wok offers a variety of beef dishes that are sure to satisfy meat lovers.

Dish Description Price
Hunan Beef Sliced beef cooked with vegetables in a spicy Hunan sauce. $12.99
Szechuan Beef Tender beef tossed in a spicy Szechuan sauce with bell peppers. $12.99
Beef Chow Mein Stir-fried noodles with beef and vegetables. $10.49

Egg Foo Young

Egg Foo Young is a classic Chinese omelette dish that’s a must-try.

Dish Description Price
Vegetable Egg Foo Young A fluffy omelet filled with assorted vegetables. $9.99
Chicken Egg Foo Young A delightful omelet with tender chicken. $10.49
Shrimp Egg Foo Young Fluffy omelet filled with succulent shrimp. $10.99

Soup

Warm up with a comforting bowl of soup. China Wok’s soups are a perfect start to any meal.

Dish Description Price
Hot and Sour Soup A spicy and tangy soup loaded with mushrooms and tofu. $3.99
Egg Drop Soup A simple yet delicious soup made with beaten eggs. $3.49
Wonton Soup Delicate wontons served in a flavorful broth. $4.99

Lo Mein

Lo Mein dishes are a customer favorite, with soft noodles tossed with various proteins and vegetables.

Dish Description Price
Chicken Lo Mein Soft noodles mixed with tender chicken and fresh vegetables. $10.49
Shrimp Lo Mein Succulent shrimp stir-fried with noodles and vegetables. $11.49
Vegetable Lo Mein A healthy option loaded with fresh vegetables. $9.99

Side Order

Don’t forget to add a side order to your meal for that extra touch!

Dish Description Price
Fried Rice Side Order A smaller portion of fried rice to complement your main dish. $4.99
Spring Rolls Side Order Two crispy spring rolls to share. $4.99

Pork

Pork lovers will enjoy the various pork dishes available at China Wok.

Dish Description Price
Roast Pork with Broccoli Tender roast pork served with fresh broccoli in brown sauce. $11.49
Sweet and Sour Pork Crispy pork tossed in a sweet and tangy sauce. $10.99

Vegetable

For those looking for lighter options, the vegetable section offers a variety of healthy choices.

Dish Description Price
Stir-Fried Vegetables A mix of fresh vegetables sautéed in a light sauce. $8.99
Vegetable Chow Mein Soft noodles stir-fried with a variety of vegetables. $9.49

Seafood

Seafood lovers will find an array of delicious dishes to choose from.

Dish Description Price
Shrimp with Garlic Sauce Jumbo shrimp sautéed with garlic and vegetables. $12.99
Scallops with Black Bean Sauce Tender scallops cooked with black bean sauce for a unique flavor. $13.99
Crab Meat with Chinese Vegetables Fresh crab meat sautéed with seasonal vegetables. $14.49

Noodle

Noodles are a fundamental part of Chinese cuisine, and China Wok excels in delivering flavorful noodle dishes.

Dish Description Price
Chow Mein Stir-fried noodles with your choice of protein and vegetables. $10.49
Mei Fun Thin rice noodles stir-fried with a variety of ingredients. $9.99

Lunch Special

Take advantage of China Wok’s lunch specials for great deals during the midday hours.

Dish Description Price
Lunch Special 1 Choice of any entrée with fried rice and egg roll. $8.99
Lunch Special 2 Two pieces of sushi with a side of miso soup. $10.49

Chop Suey

Chop Suey is a classic dish featuring meat and vegetables in a savory sauce.

Dish Description Price
Chicken Chop Suey Tender chicken sautéed with vegetables in a light sauce. $11.49
Beef Chop Suey Flavorful beef cooked with mixed vegetables. $12.49

Moo Shu

Moo Shu dishes are served with thin pancakes and are perfect for a fun dining experience.

Dish Description Price
Moo Shu Pork Sautéed pork with vegetables served with pancakes. $12.99
Moo Shu Chicken Chicken stir-fried with vegetables and served with pancakes. $12.99

Beverage

Pair your meal with refreshing beverages available on the menu.

Dish Description Price
Soft Drinks A variety of popular soft drinks to choose from. $1.99
Hot Tea Traditional Chinese tea to complement your meal. $1.49
Beer and Wine A selection of beers and wines available for those 21 and over. Prices vary.

Diet Menu

China Wok offers a diet menu for those looking for healthier dining options.

Dish Description Price
Steamed Chicken with Vegetables Lean chicken served with steamed broccoli and carrots. $10.49
Mixed Steamed Vegetables A healthy option featuring a variety of steamed vegetables. $8.99 

Looking for late-night favorites? Check out our guide to the Jack in the Box menu must‑try burgers, tacos and munchie meals to explore signature burgers, tacos, and crave-worthy munchie meals.

Conclusion

China Wok’s menu is a treasure trove of delicious dishes waiting to be explored. Whether you choose to order online, dine in, or get delivery and takeout, you are guaranteed to find something that will satisfy your cravings. Don’t forget to check out the lunch specials and unique chef’s specials for even more value. Plan your visit to China Wok today and experience the best of Chinese cuisine!
